about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, so to imitate what we revere, that we may learn to love even our enemies; for we celebrate the heavenly birthday of him who knew how to pray even for his persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we celebrate the heavenly birthday of him
who lives and reigns with You
